subject.title: Add configurable descriptive agent session labels

question: Should CodexBar support an opt-in persistent session-label preference sourced from Codex local state-database metadata?
rationale: This is a new user-facing configuration and support boundary rather than a repair to an established broken contract; maintainers need to decide whether the external metadata dependency is acceptable.

options.title: Accept the opt-in label mode
options.body: Keep Project as the default and merge after full validation confirms safe behavior across absent and variant Codex metadata.

options.title: Keep project-only labels
options.body: Decline the preference to avoid committing CodexBar to an observed external SQLite schema for display metadata.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in label mode
recommendation.body: Keep Project as the default and merge after full validation confirms safe behavior across absent and variant Codex metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is product acceptance for a new configuration surface in this personal repository.
